name: Grow Therapy vs Lyra Health
title: Grow Therapy vs Lyra Health: Private Practice vs Enterprise Platforms
description: Compare Grow Therapy (free credentialing for therapists) vs Lyra Health (enterprise workforce mental health). Understand which serves your role - provider or employer.

summary.bottom_line: Grow Therapy and Lyra Health serve completely different users. Grow Therapy is a free credentialing and practice management platform for individual therapists building private practices. Lyra Health is an enterprise B2B platform providing workforce mental health benefits to employers, serving 20M+ people globally. Individual clinicians use Grow; HR leaders contract with Lyra.

key_differences.pricing: Grow: Free (revenue share) | Lyra: Custom PEPM
key_differences.service: Grow: Practice infrastructure | Lyra: Care delivery + analytics

sections.heading: Different Sides of Mental Health
sections.content: Grow Therapy and Lyra Health operate on opposite sides of the mental health market. Grow Therapy helps therapists build their practices by handling insurance credentialing (in 5-7 days), billing, and providing practice management tools - all free with revenue sharing. Lyra Health sells to employers, providing comprehensive workforce mental health benefits with therapy, coaching, psychiatry, and AI tools - measured by ROI (3:1) and clinical outcomes.

sections.heading: Service Models
sections.content: Grow Therapy is practice infrastructure: fast credentialing, guaranteed claims, EHR, scheduling, telehealth, and AI documentation. It helps therapists get paid by insurance. Lyra Health is care delivery: employees access vetted therapists, coaches, psychiatrists, and digital tools through their employer. Lyra measures outcomes with peer-reviewed research showing 2x faster recovery and 26% reduction in healthcare claims.

sections.heading: Which Platform Do You Need?
sections.content: The answer depends on who you are:

recommendations.when: You're a therapist wanting to accept insurance clients and need practice management tools at no cost.
You're an employer (typically 500+ employees) wanting to provide mental health benefits with measurable ROI.
Therapists can use Grow for their private practice while potentially also being a provider in Lyra's network.

faqs.q: Can a therapist join both Grow Therapy and Lyra's provider network?
faqs.a: Potentially yes. You could use Grow Therapy for standard insurance credentialing while also applying to be a provider in Lyra's curated network. They serve different client populations.

faqs.q: Which is better for starting a therapy practice?
faqs.a: Grow Therapy. It's designed for individual therapists and includes everything needed to accept insurance and manage your practice. Lyra Health is an employer platform, not a practice tool.

faqs.q: Does Lyra Health help therapists get credentialed?
faqs.a: No. Lyra Health is a B2B platform for employers. Therapists may apply to join Lyra's provider network, but the platform doesn't offer credentialing services like Grow Therapy.
